findings.finding: The fused rate-half seed/top task needs four distant message quarters and its earliest complete task becomes ready only after 99.609375% of contiguous witness production. Splitting seed earlier reintroduces the 1 GiB intermediate that the current fusion deletes, followed by another read/write pass.
findings.do_not_retry: Do not add a witness-to-NTT queue unless a materially new code representation removes the four-quarter fan-in without restoring the 1 GiB intermediate.

findings.finding: Round two and the composed round-three/four traversal are separated by observing the deferred round-three message and sampling rho. A one-pass formulation requires unknown-rho symbolic state or retained/replayed rows, recreating the closed multi-gigabyte representation problem.
findings.do_not_retry: Do not tune chunk count or replay packed rows; reopen only with a new algebraic representation that crosses the Fiat-Shamir boundary soundly.

findings.finding: A register-resident fused-four plus fused-two pass needs four 16-row groups live at once, or 64 payload ZMM registers before twiddles, on a 32-ZMM machine. The only source-counted F4 setup residual is 15 companions versus 2560 VPCLMUL per row group, a 0.586% upper bound below about 0.13 ms.
findings.do_not_retry: Do not revive LOW2, TWPREP companions, prefetch removal, shaped dispatch, or two-butterfly ILP without a distinct arithmetic reduction and spill-free assembly proof.

findings.finding: The ranked DirectFold8 L1 precommit already overlaps the full L1 commit with the GFNI/M6 sibling. L1 rate-one-quarter seed tasks need four quarter rows and the current global Rayon join has no bounded worker-partition surface. Ring-switch itself is only about 0.4 to 0.45 ms.
findings.do_not_retry: Do not pursue ring-switch-only, f8 reread, or static worker-split riders unless a current proof-window measurement shows at least 2.1 ms of non-overlapped critical-path work.
